# SDE (chemical Langevin) parity goldens

Byte-identical copies of `go-pflow/stochastic/testdata/sde/<name>.json`,
generated by go-pflow's `cmd/sde-goldens` — the SDE counterpart of
`cmd/ssa-goldens`. Same portable-path randomness (SplitMix64 → xoshiro256\*\*,
ported fdlibm log via `plog`, the Marsaglia-polar `normal()`), the same five
models and the same per-model options (horizon/samples/realizations/seed) as
`tests/fixtures/ssa/`, so the two golden sets describe identical nets under
two different engines. `tests/sde_parity.rs` runs every file here through
`pflow_solver::ssa::sde::simulate_sde` and asserts `==` on every parsed
double. **Never regenerate a golden to make a test pass** — a difference
means the sample path (or, for a diverged fixture, the refusal) changed.

**Two of the five carry no series.** `gates.json` and `coffeeshop.json` both
gate firing in ways continuous diffusion cannot express (a read arc, an
inhibitor, a non-kinetic input, or a reachable capacity — `gates` by
construction, `coffeeshop` because its three restock transitions make
`coffee_beans`/`milk`/`cups`'s capacities reachable). Their goldens record
`"diverged": true` and the engine's own `reason`/`caveats` strings — copied
from `metamodel.Model.Gating()`'s exact wording (arc counts, `[a b c]`-style
place lists) — rather than a fabricated series. That refusal string is itself
part of the byte-exact contract: `pflow_solver::ssa::sde::simulate_sde`'s own
`gating_reasons` was rewritten to match go-pflow's wording field for field
(see its doc comment) rather than leaving the two prose forms free to drift,
which is how this port's earlier reasons — "a read arc has no continuous
analogue", with no arc count or place list — first read. `chain`, `sir` and
`dimer` are unconstrained mass-action nets and carry a normal
`expected.times`/`expected.series`/`expected.final`.

The sha256 of every file here is pinned in `go-pflow.lock` at the repo root
(one lock for every golden vendored from go-pflow — ROADMAP.md ground rule
2), verified offline with `./scripts/go-pflow-goldens.sh check` and
refreshed from a go-pflow checkout with `./scripts/go-pflow-goldens.sh sync`.

Each file's generating commit is named in its own `_comment` field
(`d84dc017bfe42acd03176b74a7bb91878d72d5f1-dirty` — go-pflow's `cmd/sde-goldens`,
`cmd/scheduled-goldens`, `cmd/bundle-goldens` and `cmd/properties-goldens`
generator programs themselves were new, uncommitted files in the go-pflow
working tree when these goldens were generated, hence `-dirty`; the commit
they were generated *against* is the same one the rest of `go-pflow.lock`
already pins, and none of these four generators change anything the existing
goldens depend on).

Two of the five fixtures (`gates`, `coffeeshop`) are the ones worth reading
first if you want to see the refusal path exercised: `simulate_sde` never
draws a random number for either, since `gating_reasons` short-circuits
before `sde_path` runs.
